status_summary: No EPA action on the five management items was found in the sources read. The Office of Mountains, Deserts and Plains was created in September 2020 for western hardrock mine cleanups; in October 2025 its acting director was reported as overseeing EPA's review of applications under the statutory Good Samaritan abandoned mine pilot program, and no expansion of the office was found. EPA's Superfund Solutions release of 2026-06-03 describes faster investigations and more state cooperation but does not mention five-year reviews, delegations, project management training or Lean management.
title: Superfund management: PRP five-year reviews, mines office, delegations, Lean training
uncertainties: A trade report of 2025-10-29 (Inside EPA, paywalled) says a merged Office of Superfund and Emergency Management was to launch on 2025-11-02; its effect on the mines office or on delegations is unknown and it is not an event (see c13-29). The office's acting status in 2025 suggests it is not fully stood up, but staffing was not found. Delegations of authority and Lean Management System use are internal documents that may not be published, and EPA's delegations manual was not searched. Searches performed: four web searches (the mines office, twice including one in review; five-year reviews with Lean and delegation; OLEM reorganization), which returned mostly older regional documents, the 2020 launch release and the Good Samaritan program report. This record covers only items not tracked in c13-28 (National Contingency Plan, removals, ARARs, lead plan), c13-29 (RCRA and OLEM restructuring) and c13-08 (PFAS designation and groundwater rules).
